summary: Entecavir Anhydrous has received the highest level of warning in the United States because it can cause severe liver damage, immune system issues, and problems with how the body processes energy [3][6]. Stopping the drug can cause severe flare-ups of hepatitis B, an infection of the liver, so patients must have their liver function watched closely [6]. The FDA label also warns against using this medication in people who have both HIV and hepatitis B unless they are also taking specific combination therapy [6]. Additionally, a small computer model that was not tested on people estimated a high score for liver harm and a low score for heart harm [M].
